verdict.rationale: Unreal provides event-driven building blocks: C++ delegates can be bound to a member function on any object and fire it at a future time [unreal-docs-3, unreal-docs-20], and Blueprints give designers programmer-level scripting [unreal-docs-1]. Python editor scripting and the Automation Tool automate repetitive tasks [unreal-docs-26, unreal-docs-35, unreal-docs-30], but these are task scripts, not event-triggered rules, so users must code their own event-to-action logic. Missing for 10: a documented declarative rules or trigger system for defining event-to-action automations, explicit docs on Blueprint event handling, any event-triggered editor or pipeline hooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
